items.title: 葬礼 2063
items.one_liner: 制作周期较长，首映礼暂定 2063 年。
items.description: 一直在筹办自己的葬礼。欢迎 2063 年来参加。我是一个内向且……礼貌的人，所以葬礼可能是唯一一个场合：每个人都在和我交流，而我又不用社交。所以，我得好好筹划，不能搞砸我人生最喜欢、也最重要的时刻。毕竟我不能亲自到场，活着。

en.title: Funeral 2063
en.one_liner: A long production. Premiere tentatively scheduled for 2063.
en.description: I have been planning my own funeral for a while. You are invited in 2063. I am introverted and… polite, so a funeral may be the only occasion where everyone is talking to me and I do not have to socialize. I should plan it well. It would be a shame to ruin my favorite — and most important — moment of my life. After all, I will not be able to attend in person. Alive.

items.cover_alt: 生命之树 green book cover

zh.title: 生命之树
zh.one_liner: 找出不该变的，才知道其余一切该怎么变。
zh.description: 《生命之树》是我的精神基地，也是一个持续进行的人生实验：在一个不断变化、充满偶然、无法完全控制的世界里，一个有限的人，如何找到不变之物，并据此理解、判断、行动，再让现实不断修正自己。它以「愿、悟、道、法、术、器、例、场、运、势」为十个根，连接从“什么值得发生”，到“如何看见真实”，再到判断、行动、反馈，以及我们无法逃离的环境、运气与趋势。另一个我常用的问法是：如何让幸福不只靠运气？不是消灭运气，而是让自己更能识别现实、做出判断、采取行动、从后果中学习，也给好运留下可以落地的接口。目前仍在持续修订，尚未正式出版；感兴趣可以邮件联系我。

en.title: Tree of Life
en.one_liner: Find what should not change, so everything else can.
en.description: Tree of Life is my spiritual base and an ongoing attempt to answer one question: how should a finite person live in a world that never stops changing? Its ten roots — 愿, 悟, 道, 法, 术, 器, 例, 场, 运, 势 — connect what is worth pursuing with reality, judgment, action, feedback, circumstance, chance, and momentum. Another way I ask the same question is: how can happiness depend less on luck? Not by eliminating luck, but by becoming better able to recognize reality, make sound judgments, act, learn from consequences, choose better environments, and give good fortune somewhere to land. The manuscript is still under revision and has not yet been formally published; if it resonates, feel free to email me.
en.cover_alt: Tree of Life green book cover

items.title: Not Today
items.one_liner: Asymmetric tower defense meets first-person combat.
items.description: A team game project built at USC around an asymmetric two-sided battle. One player enters the world in first-person and pushes through the map, while the opposing player controls the battlefield from a tower-defense view; the roles can then reverse. The project combined first-person shooting, tower-defense strategy, stereoscopic 3D, and VR into one competitive game prototype.
items.cover_alt: Not Today fantasy VR game artwork
